value.name: withhold helpful intervention
value.description: Asha realizes that even small gestures like clearing her throat or naming the deadline would be another way of choosing for Devin, so she restrains herself.
evidence: any small helpful thing she did now—clearing her throat, naming the deadline again, sliding the pen—would be a way of choosing for him, and she had already used up her allowance of choosing for him in the car on the way over.

value.name: hold position beside the table
value.description: Asha stays still at the table, keeping her hand at her side and her eyes on Devin instead of moving or blinking away.
evidence: Her hand stayed at her side, her eyes on Devin, and she did not let herself blink the look away or shift her weight against the table edge to ease the ache that had settled into her lower back somewhere on the drive over.

value.name: leave pen within Devin's reach
value.description: Asha leaves the pen near the briefcase on her side of the table, forcing Devin to reach across the page if he wants it.
evidence: The pen lay where she had set it down, near the briefcase, closer to her side of the table than to his, and she did not correct that either; whatever he reached for, he would have to reach across the page to do it.

value.name: release held breath
value.description: Asha exhales and lets her shoulders drop slightly, but she still refuses to fill the silence.
evidence: Asha let out a breath she had not realized she was holding so tight, and her shoulders dropped a quarter inch against the line of her jacket.
She kept her eyes on Devin and did not fill the space the breath had opened.

value.name: wait for Devin to move first
value.description: Asha watches Devin struggle with the silence and deliberately waits for him to make the first move.
evidence: The small muscle at his jaw tightened again and stayed tightened this time, and she watched him watch the page, the corner of the filing where his name would go catching the lamp at an angle that made the blank line look longer than it was.
She waited inside the quiet and let him be the one who had to move first.

value.name: remain motionless in silence
value.description: Asha continues to hold still and watch Devin as the scene ends mid-thought.
